name: zoom
description: Search meetings, pull transcripts, and work with Zoom Docs.

CLIENT_ID.title: Zoom Client ID
CLIENT_ID.description: Public Client ID (recommended) or Client ID from your Zoom App Marketplace General app → Basic Information → App Credentials. The Public Client ID appears after turning on Use Public Client OAuth.

CLIENT_SECRET.title: Zoom Client Secret
CLIENT_SECRET.description: Optional. Leave blank with a Public Client ID; Cursor then signs in with PKCE and no secret. Only set it alongside the confidential Client ID from the same app.
